core_obligations: Bounded case (proof lines 6459-6468): the author applies the companion bounded statement, together with the identification of the relevant categories of complexes, to obtain the equivalence on the bounded below derived categories.

Pass to the unbounded case (proof lines 6468-6479): using the companion result that every object of the subcategory is the derived limit of its truncations, the author shows that the functors are mutually inverse on the unbounded derived categories, which gives the asserted equivalence.
proof_roadmap: Apply the companion bounded equivalence on the bounded below derived categories.
Use the recovery of objects as derived limits of truncations to pass to the unbounded categories.
Conclude the equivalence with quasi-inverse Rf_*.
difficulty_reason: The lemma upgrades the bounded equivalence of derived categories of suitable weak Serre subcategories to the unbounded case, in the variant where both sides satisfy the Olsson-Laszlo situation (statement lines 6433-6457, whose annotation block is a comment-type environment and is delivered as written). The proof applies the companion bounded statement (proof lines 6459-6468) and then passes to the unbounded categories using the companion recovery of objects as derived limits of their truncations (proof lines 6468-6479). The non-formal content is the passage from bounded below to unbounded using the truncation recovery. The claim is H2: one companion statement plus one limiting argument.
